title: iArch by Safari contact page defaults
description: The Contact page's data. Version 2 replaced the version 1 'links' array with a portfolio block and a fixed list of row kinds, because the page needs to know which row is the primary button and which rows are placeholders a person fills in. A row with an empty value is hidden by the page, not shown disabled; a row with a value the link validator refuses is shown with the reason. Only https, mailto and tel values are ever opened.

display_name.description: Shown as the Contact page's title. Empty is allowed: the page falls back to the maintainer named in branding/product.env.

role.description: Shown as the subtitle under the title.

url.description: Must agree with PORTFOLIO_URL in iarch/settings-app/iarch_settings/services/links.py; tests/test_settings_links.py asserts the two match, so the address cannot be changed in one place only.

note.description: The one line under the primary button. The portfolio holds the social links, so the page says that instead of listing them twice.

kind.description: An identifier the page matches on. It is not a display string and is not translated.

subtitle.description: Optional second line. Usually the address without its scheme, which is what a person recognises.

icon.description: A freedesktop symbolic icon name. Every name the application uses is verified against the icon theme in data/design/adwaita.json, and tests/test_settings_surface.py checks this file's icons against that record too.

value.description: The URI to open, or an empty string for a placeholder row the page hides. Validated at load time by services/links.py; a non-empty value that is refused is shown with the reason rather than opened.
